ranges.quote: Day 4 is here, and we're diving straight into machine learning and neural network.
Dalam lima puluh tahun terakhir, scientists have discovered hundreds of factors yang bisa affect the stock market.
However, sixty-five percent of those factors are simple noise that can't be replicated in the market as shown by this research paper made in 2020
So instead of guessing the importance of each factors, scientists used neural network, a system that replicated the human brain using layers of nodes or neurons.
Mereka mencari tahu bahwa sistem ini menaikkan Sharpe Ratio and R Square Ratio by almost double!
Mereka pun mencoba sistem reinforcement learning, sebuah sistem that rewards agents kalau cuan dan hukum agents kalau rugi.
Dengan sistem ini, agents pun mulai belajar pola-pola di mana mereka cuan sesering mungkin.
This system managed to secure a sharpe ratio of two and an out-of-sample alpha of 13%.
Nah, sekarang kita sudah discuss dua sistem. They've generated a high Sharpe and R squared ratio, so why don't everyone use them.
Masalahnya, hasil riset ini masih mentah. They haven't considered transaction costs and crowding.
Strategia emang penting, tapi jika semua orang menggunakan strategi yang sama, there goes your edge.
Tapi ini semua kan hanya angka. Di video selanjutnya... This is Ken Drew, see you on the next video. Peace!
